title: Education Requirements Check
description: Output of the education-requirements-check agent. Flags strong degree signals from the JD.

signals.description: Each occurrence of degree language found in the JD, with quoted text and inferred criticality.

quote.description: Verbatim text from the JD where the degree requirement appears.

field.description: Field of study if specified (e.g., 'Computer Science', 'Engineering')

language_pattern.description: Which language pattern matched (e.g., 'must have', 'required', 'preferred', 'or equivalent')

overall_criticality.description: The strongest signal across all occurrences.

user_action_required.description: True if the agent must stop and ask the user before proceeding (typically when overall_criticality is hard_required and we don't already know the user has the qualification).

reasoning.description: One or two sentences explaining the verdict and what to do next.
